Additionally, we showcase the potential of our method for real-world applications, such as estimating material properties from a single image in a mobile augmented reality setting. identifying the most important words or phrases from a given text. This task is essential
for summarizing long documents and generating metadata. Current state-of-the-art models
rely on powerful GPUs or TPUs, but these are not suitable for edge devices such as
smartphones and IoT devices. This paper presents a novel approach to keyphrase
extraction that can run on low-power devices, using a combination of pre-trained models
and efficient neural networks. This method achieves a high accuracy of 0.74 F1-score on
the standard dataset, while requiring only 0.5 MB of memory and taking 0.1 seconds to
process a single text. This makes it suitable for real-time applications on edge devices.

RingCT, a privacy-enhancing protocol, has been widely used in blockchain systems, particularly in the Monero cryptocurrency. It involves delegating a portion of the ring size to a central authority, allowing for a more efficient transaction processing time. Theoretical analysis and simulation results demonstrate that Delegated RingCT can achieve a substantial increase in transaction speed without compromising anonymity. The proposed method is compatible with existing Monero blockchain implementations, making it a viable solution for improving the performance of RingCT-based blockchain systems. The COVID-19 pandemic has led to a significant increase in remote work, prompting organizations to reassess their project management strategies. The results indicate that working from home has a negative effect on project success, and that this outcome is influenced by team characteristics, such as experience and communication skills. Furthermore, the study identifies specific factors that contribute to the success of remote Scrum projects, including team cohesion, communication, and the ability to adapt to new circumstances. The findings of this study can inform organizations and project managers on how to mitigate the challenges associated with remote work and improve the success of Scrum projects. The study also provides recommendations for future research on this topic. This research introduces a novel control strategy for improving the precision of industrial robots by utilizing supplementary position sensors. The flatness based control strategy is demonstrated through simulations and practical experiments using a KUKA LBR iiwa robot. The proposed method is particularly beneficial for robots that require high precision, such as those used in assembly and medical applications. In the context of preference learning, we examine the task of predicting user preferences for adding items to a set. Our model, which we call Contextual Additive Preference (CAP), uses a neural network to predict user preferences based on the items in the set and the item to be added. We evaluate CAP against a non-contextual baseline model and find that it significantly outperforms it on a real-world dataset. Additionally, we investigate the importance of contextual information in this task and find that it is not always necessary. Our results suggest that CAP can be used as a general-purpose model for set addition problems and that it is worth considering the specific use case to determine whether contextual information is necessary. In neural machine translation, the focus mechanism has been used to selectively
consider source words during translation. However, this approach only looks back at
previous source words, neglecting potential insights from later source words. To
address this limitation, we introduce a novel look-ahead focus mechanism that
allows the model to simultaneously consider both preceding and subsequent source
words. Experimental results on three language pairs demonstrate that this enhanced
focus mechanism leads to improved translation quality, with significant gains of
+0.8 and +1.1 BLEU points observed on the newstest2014 and newstest2015 datasets of
the WMT16 test suite, respectively. Furthermore, our model outperforms the
baseline on the WMT17 test suite, achieving a +0.4 and +0.5 BLEU point improvement
on the newstest2017 and newstest2018 datasets, respectively. The code is
available at https://github.com/kevincyli/lookahead_focus.
